features.quote: The loop stops at the category turn budget or on the give-up sentinel.
`give_up` is a sentinel string (`<GIVE_UP>`) the model is *told about* in the system prompt
the system prompt frames it neutrally as an option, so its presence is informative about the model's state
features.justification_quote: apparent "distress" is not an artifact of the model feeling unable to stop

features.quote: Give-up behavior is itself welfare-relevant signal, so it is recorded in `stop_reason`.
